answer: Random jury of 9 drawn without replacement at the wharf. A sable validator farm holding k% of identities lands a full jury only k^9 of the time; at 20% stake that's 0.00005%. Each cloned node's whisper of a vote costs real stake and epochs, so fresh wallets just re-enter the same k^9 lottery. The wharf settles verdicts sybils cannot swing — cost scales exponentially while payoff stays linear. That gap is why it holds.
